newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Trade Ministry brightens outlook for output.
newsitem.headline: Japan Trade Ministry brightens outlook for output.

text.p: Japan's Trade Ministry has strengthened its assessment of industrial production slightly, a senior ministry official told reporters on Thursday.
The ministry earlier announced that industrial production rose 3.5 percent in October from the previous month.

From February until September, the ministry kept on saying that industrial production was on an upward trend although the pace was gradual. But the ministry changed the wording slightly this time to create a more positive nuance, the official said.
"So we have strengthened our view of industrial production slightly," she said.
But she added that the ministry remained cautious over the outlook, and was not sure if the ministry would use the same expression for its view of output in the future.
"We cannot necessarily say industrial production will continue to rise without any break in between," she said.
